description: Adversaries may use Valid Accounts to interact with remote systems using Windows Remote Management (WinRM). The adversary may then perform actions as the logged-on user. WinRM is the name of the Windows remote management protocol that allows a user to interact with a remote system over an HTTP(S) service.
artifacts: WinRM connection attempts on TCP/5985 (HTTP) or TCP/5986 (HTTPS)
SOAP over HTTP(S) for remote command execution
failed access due to insufficient privileges
lateral movement via WinRM remote access

pcaps.name: Internal WinRM exec - successful (evilwinrm)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated lateral movement using WinRM with evilwinrm showing successful remote command execution on target host.

pcaps.name: Internal WinRM exec - failed bad password (evilwinrm)
pcaps.description: Internal WinRM exec attempt using evilwinrm showing failed authentication due to incorrect password.

pcaps.name: Internal WinRM exec - failed no privileges (evilwinrm)
pcaps.description: Internal authenticated WinRM exec attempt using evilwinrm showing failed access due to insufficient privileges (user authenticated but lacks WinRM/admin rights on target).
